full_page.content:
c. 1919, August
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 3.
Pg. 3b. Retreat ( con't)
10:45
Means of Progress
Prayer - meditation, who prays well - better - best. Spiritual reading Good intention Ejaculator prayer
Silence - especially about others faults.
Holy Communion - sacramental and spiritual .* 2:30 P.M.
Venial Sin - its danger, perversity, next to mortal sin worst that can happen. 7:30 Fortitude (a) necessity (b) perpetual (c) Reward.
23rd. A.M.
Conclusion
Devotion to the Sacred Heart and to Our Bl. Mother Mary .
*St. Columba's only nourishment for seven years, Holy Communion till her death at 28. Pope Innocent VIII.
END OF NOTEBOOK No. 3.
